_comment: Scripts that legitimately appear in an edition below its dominant-script
threshold, verified by hand. Everything not listed here that trips the
foreign-script check is a real defect, so keep this file short and only add
an entry after actually reading the verses it covers.

en-sahih.why: The honorific SAW (U+FDFA) in 34 verses, always inside a bracketed gloss on the Prophet's name.

it-piccardo.why: 35:45 carries a genuine etymology note deriving 'angelo' from the Greek. The lone Cyrillic character sits inside that same Greek word and is itself a homoglyph typo, tracked separately rather than repaired here.
